setting_refresh.description: Refresh interval in seconds for the dashboard view.

setting_boxsize.description: Grid box size for the dashboard layout.

include_softstate.description: Include soft states (pending) in the dashboard. Set to '0' to exclude.

requires_authentication.description: Require authentication to access the dashboard. Set to '0' to allow anonymous access.

show_legend.description: Show the legend in the dashboard. Set to '0' to hide.

path_prefix.description: The URL prefix where Icinga Web 2 is installed.
